name: Velvet Antenna v0.22.0 Antenna Flow
author: James
description: Major standalone Velvet Antenna viewer release. Antenna Flow replaces conventional home shelves with Continue the Story, Tonight, One More Episode, Forgotten Signals, Rediscover and transparent Signal Match recommendations; adds finish-time intelligence and Series continuity; removes the temporary Needs ID/Duplicates viewer tools; and adds in-player CC+ remote subtitle search with Download & Use via configured Jellyfin subtitle providers. Built on the proven v0.21.5 playback/navigation/admin compatibility base.
